summary: An adviser waits for the member to name the procedural question before offering an answer.
realLife: Riddick described answering the specific question each senator brought him so that advice to one member would not disclose another member’s business.

turns.what: The adviser asks which motion is pending.
The adviser gives the same procedural explanation.
turns.pulledBy: A second member asks the same question.
turns.writesBack: Each consultation retains its own record.
